content.title: About
content.content: The soy-based nutritional drink is a liquid shake made from soy protein, fortified with vitamins and minerals. It provides a quick source of energy and nutrients, is convenient to consume, and is suitable for vegetarians and vegans.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Soy protein contains all essential amino acids, making it a complete protein source.
The drink is often fortified with calcium and vitamin D to mimic the nutritional profile of milk.
Soy isoflavones may help support hormonal balance in women.
Because it is liquid, the shake is rapidly absorbed and ideal for post‑workout consumption.
In many countries soy drinks are a popular alternative to dairy smoothies.

items.title: Rich source of protein
items.content: One serving provides about 20 g of protein, aiding muscle recovery and promoting satiety.

items.title: Low in saturated fat
items.content: Soy drinks contain minimal saturated fat, making them heart‑friendly.

items.title: B‑vitamin complex
items.content: Fortified with riboflavin (B2), cobalamin (B12) and folate, which support energy metabolism.

items.title: Calcium and vitamin D
items.content: Added calcium and vitamin D help maintain bone health, especially for those who avoid dairy.

items.title: Gut‑health support
items.content: Some versions include probiotics that promote a healthy digestive microbiome.

items.title: Soy allergy
items.content: People allergic to soy may experience severe reactions upon consumption.

items.title: Phytoestrogen content
items.content: Isoflavones can affect hormonal balance; individuals with hormone‑sensitive conditions should consult a doctor.

items.title: Added sugar
items.content: Certain formulations contain sugar; choose unsweetened versions if monitoring weight or diabetes.

items.title: GMO
items.content: Most commercial soy is genetically modified; look for “non‑GMO” labeling if you wish to avoid GMOs.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Drink the shake chilled straight from the bottle. It can be blended into smoothies, used as a base for protein cocktails, or enjoyed as a quick snack between meals.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in the refrigerator at 2 °C–6 °C. After opening, consume within 5–7 days. Do not freeze, as the texture may change.
